newsitem.title: USA: Whistler acquires Stanley Works unit.
newsitem.headline: Whistler acquires Stanley Works unit.

text.p: Whistler Corp, the privately-held maker of radar-laser detection products and auto security systems, said Friday it completed its acquisition of the Garage-Related Products Units of Stanley Works ond HSN Marketing on Feb 14.

The acquisitions, said the company, are representative of its aggressive plan to grow and diversify its operations. The Stanley Garage-Related Products acquisition augments Whistler's offerings with a line of garage doors and openers, gate openers and other related electronic systems. The HSN acquisition provides Whistler with a line of 12 volt products including power inverters, portable power stations, in-car appliances, air compressors and other 12 volt accessories. Whistler's projected 1997 revenue will approximate $200 million.
